lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A linear horizontal arrangement of five high-luminance elliptical blobs is visible along the mid-lateral axis of the caudal peduncle, followed by a cluster of approximately 10-12 circular blobs at the base of the caudal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible on the caudal peduncle, intersecting the horizontal blob sequence to form a faint grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the dorsal-lateral margin of the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a sharp intensity gradient between the illuminated upper surface and the shadowed lower portion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, irregular indentation is present on the ventral margin of the caudal peduncle, approximately 1/3 of the distance from the left frame edge to the caudal fin origin.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower lobe of the caudal fin features a dense, vertically-oriented distribution of high-luminance spots organized into three primary columns.
